title: Health and Human Services Workforce Visa Act
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on the Judiciary, and in addition to the Committees on Agriculture, Energy and Commerce, Ways and Means, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
